make_flat_atom_layout: create a flat AtomLayout from a Residues object using CCD chemical component data and bond information
compute_gather_idxs: compute gather indices and mask to convert atom data from a source layout to a target layout
convert: convert a numpy or jax array from one atom layout to another using GatherInfo indices
make_structure: build a Structure object from a flat AtomLayout and atom coordinate arrays with optional B-factors
residues_from_structure: extract a Residues object with terminus and deprotonation info from a Structure including missing residues
